actual: Production parent ahrop_db1f7525cc28b739b1eb013ce73280ec was queued; the database still enforced UNIQUE(batch_id, operation_idempotency_key), and the repository lookup also omitted operation_type, so the BUILD_DATASET_BRIDGE_RUN child could neither coexist with nor be read independently from its parent.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: BUG-902 added distinct parent and RUN operation types but left the database idempotency constraint and repository lookup scoped only by batch_id and operation_idempotency_key. The bridge parent and child intentionally share a key, so both schema and repository must use the same three-part identity: batch_id, operation_type and operation_idempotency_key.

events.note: DEV catalog proved BUG-902 left the global idempotency constraint in place; added forward and rollback migrations so schema and repository share one exact identity contract.

expected: The database unique constraint and repository lookup both scope operation identity by batch, operation type and key, so parent and RUN child sharing a key coexist and exact retries resolve only their own type.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
reproduce_command: Run R5 build_dataset_bridge for completed batch ahrb_dccde5770463663ecbde96fbe304cd26 with a parent/RUN shared idempotency key
title: R5 bridge operation lookup ignores operation type
